'''Jeff Podolak''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2000 Glenside tournament]] on 2 April 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]], according to Kim Caton's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d451">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-03-glenside-pa-4-2d451/ glenside-pa-4-2], DeckTech (Kimberly "Arwen Even*" Caton, 3 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-03-glenside-pa-4-2d451/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
